items.headline: JFB Construction and XTEND Clear SEC S-4 Review, Target Sept. 1 Closing For XTEND AI Robotics Merger; Expected To Trade On The NYSE Under The Ticker Symbol "XTND"
items.summary: ~ Effectiveness of Form S-4 Clears Final Regulatory Milestone Ahead of Closing ~~ Combined Company to be Renamed XTEND AI Robotics, with Closing Anticipated September 1, 2026, and Expected to Trade on the New York Stock
